Before: One paragraph on what the repository did, or lacked, before this change.

After: One paragraph on what it does now.

What: One sentence.

How: The approach taken, and what was considered and set aside.

## Adversarial review

What a reviewer who wanted the change to fail checked, by reading it or by running it, what they found and what was fixed. The required check fails while this is missing, too short or still this text (CONTRIBUTING.md).
